title: Ringed-topos pullback in the acyclic K-flat case
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be sites essentially small in a fixed coefficient universe, let $R$ on $C$ and $S$ on $D$ be sheaves of commutative rings, and let $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ be a morphism of their sheaf topoi, with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits. Fix its algebraic inverse image on ring and module sheaves and a ring homomorphism $c:u^{-1}R\to S$. Write $u^*$ for the additive module pullback, inverse image followed by extension of scalars [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], applied termwise to cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. If $P$ is acyclic (all its cohomology objects vanish), K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], and flat in every degree [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then $u^*P$ is K-flat.

source.place: Tag 0G7E (sites-cohomology-lemma-pullback-K-flat), acyclic case; direct good-truncation variant using Tag 0G7C

proof.text: The acyclic K-flat cycles criterion [lem-weil-pbc-site-acyclic-kflat-cycles-flat] gives flat cycles in every degree. The good truncation at n has the original terms below n, this flat cycle sheaf at n, and zero terms above n. Its terms are therefore flat and it is bounded above.

Apply flat-module pullback [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-flat-module-pullback] to the terms of each good truncation. Additivity preserves the zero terms, so its image remains bounded above. Apply the proved independent-universe bounded-above flat criterion [lem-weil-pbc-independent-bounded-flat-kflat] directly to that image.

The good truncations indexed by natural numbers have degreewise colimit P: they are eventually equal to P in any fixed degree. The specified module pullback preserves this colimit by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-pullback-filtered-colimits]. Filtered-colimit closure of K-flatness [lem-pc-module-filtered-colimits-tensor] now gives the conclusion. This avoids a second replacement tower and avoids flat-quotient short exact sequences.

theorem isKFlat_ringedToposPullback_of_acyclic
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [EssentiallySmall.{w} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} D]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {R : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{w}} {S RI : Sheaf JD CommRingCat.{w}}
    (uInv : Sheaf JC (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type (w)))
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type (w)))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage uInv R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (uStar : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JD
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj S))
    (hobj : ∀ M : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R),
      uStar.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M))
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      uStar.map a = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
        changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    [uStar.Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hacyclic : P.Acyclic) (hP : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JC) (R := R) (P.X n)) :
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      ((uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
